class.name: HTTPResponse
class.brief_description: The outbound half of one HTTP exchange.
class.description: A handler sets [member status] and any header fields it needs, then commits the body exactly once with [method send], [method send_string], [method redirect] or [method send_file]. A second commit is an error and leaves the first one intact. This class lives in the [code]foundry.http.server[/code] namespace, so it is reached either by its fully qualified name [code skip-lint]foundry.http.server.HTTPResponse[/code] or, after [code]import foundry.http.server[/code], by the bare name [code]HTTPResponse[/code]. Without that import the bare name does not resolve. [b]Note:[/b] Committing does not write to a socket yet. It records what will be written, so the result is only observable through the getters on this class.

method.name: get_body
method.description: Returns the committed body bytes. Empty when nothing was committed, or when the body is a file.

method.name: get_body_source
method.description: Returns where the body comes from: nothing committed yet, bytes held in memory, or a file on disk.

method.name: get_body_string
method.description: Returns the committed body bytes decoded as UTF-8.

method.name: get_file_path
method.description: Returns the path passed to [method send_file], or an empty string when the body does not come from a file.

method.name: get_header
method.description: Returns the value set for the [param name] header field, or an empty string when it is not set. The lookup is case-insensitive.

method.name: get_headers
method.description: Returns a copy of the header fields that will be written, keyed by the name as it was first spelled. Mutating the returned dictionary does not change the response.

method.name: has_header
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the [param name] header field is set. The lookup is case-insensitive.

method.name: is_sent
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] once the body has been committed.

method.name: redirect
method.description: Commits an empty body, sets [member status] to [param status] and sets the [code]Location[/code] header field to [param location]. [param status] must be a redirection status between [code]300[/code] and [code]399[/code], and [param location] must not be empty; otherwise nothing is committed and the response is left unchanged.

method.name: send
method.description: Commits [param body] as the response body, byte for byte.

method.name: send_file
method.description: Commits the file at [param path] as the response body. The path is recorded rather than read, so a missing file is not reported here. An empty path is rejected and commits nothing.

method.name: send_string
method.description: Commits the UTF-8 encoding of [param body] as the response body.

method.name: set_header
method.description: Sets the [param name] header field to [param value], replacing any value set earlier under a different casing of the same name. An empty name is rejected.

members.member: The HTTP status code of the response. Must be between [code]100[/code] and [code]599[/code]; values outside that range are rejected and leave the property unchanged.

constants.constant: The body is the byte buffer returned by [method get_body].
The body is the file at [method get_file_path].
